question: The distribution of the population according to different types of occupation is known as __________.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Occupational Structure __**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Occupational structure mentions** to the aggregate distribution of occupations in society, determined by skill level, economic function, or social rank**.
 
• Many factors effect the occupational structure, counting the** economy's structure, technology and bureaucracy, the labor market, and status and prestige.**
 
• The occupational structure is the allocation of occupations in the community, arranged according to economic function, skill level, or social status.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Age Composition** in population studies, the proportionate numbers of persons in successive age groups in a given population. 
 
• Age distributions differ between countries mainly due to differences in the **levels and trends of fertility.**
 
• **An important feature of population growth in India is the development of its adolescents**.
 
 
• Currently, the share of adolescents i.e., up to the age group of 10-19 years is around **20.9 percent** (2011), among which male adolescents constitute **52.7 percent **and female adolescents constitute** 47.3 percent.**
 
 
 
• **Migration** is the movement of a person from one country, locality, place of residence, etc., to settle in another.
